name: Trackball Scroll Mode
author: Anton Borodavkin (Goomba41)
description: Turn a trackball or mouse into a smooth, precise scroll wheel. Tap a hotkey to switch between pointer and scrolling, or hold it for a momentary sniper mode; pointer mode leaves the device untouched, so there is no added latency. Tune speed, axis lock, inertia and a learned side button in the native panel, read and set mouse DPI stages through libratbag with deterministic colours, watch local rolling statistics, and install the background service with one click. Bar widget, English and Russian included.

barWidget.description: Trackball pointer/scroll mode indicator and toggle
